text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...
Phew—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...Yes!
I just gave it the best run I possibly could...!
With this—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right, I have to make an appeal!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All the way from Tomakomai—!!
I'm Hokko Tarumae—!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Warm, kind, and full of charm—that's Tomakomai!!
Please give us a waaaarm welcomeーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up with that girl?
...Is she promoting something?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai... that's in Hokkaido, right?
Like a local PR thing? That's pretty rare.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Tarumae-chan, you've got such a great look on your face.
Your run was reeeally good too~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Coming all the way to Kyoto to watch was totally worth it~!
Let's head over to the waiting rooms later!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was able to give everything I've built up
until today my absolute all...!
choice_data_list: I'm sure the people of Tomakomai are delighted too

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...This is where the story of
Hokko Tarumae, the dirt Umamusume,
truly begins.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best to spread the word about Tomakomai even more...!
So—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again from here on out!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Looking forward to working with you too!
Yeah! The pleasure is all mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, sharing the joy of a successful debut race
with Hokko Tarumae, we fired ourselves up
to take our next step forward...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The day after the debut race.
During a meeting to discuss Hokko Tarumae's future goals—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...
Nnnmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... I knew it all along, but just debuting
hasn't really brought a dramatic surge in interest
for me or Tomakomai, has it...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I search my name, I see people from Tomakomai being happy,
but very few new people have learned
about me or Tomakomai...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Of course, knowing everyone in Tomakomai
is happy gives me so much encouragement!
I even replied to every single post I could see!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
However—
as the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador,
I need to raise our profile even more...!
choice_data_list: What do you want to do from here on out, Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um... I want to produce results in big races and draw attention as a dirt Umamusume.
Because having that attention directly translates into a stronger voice.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Still, at the same time, I want to raise awareness of Hokko Tarumae as a local idol.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Only when the recognition of both 'Dirt Umamusume' and 'Local Idol' come together will the promotional effect as a tourism ambassador be at its absolute maximum...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I agree with her thinking. Going forward, she'll need to grow from the perspective of both a 'dirt Umamusume' and a 'local idol.'
choice_data_list: Then let's set a goal that achieves both.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A goal that fulfills both, is it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know I brought it up myself, but
can they really be connected...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to explain my thoughts
to Hokko Tarumae step by step—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, for Hokko Tarumae to challenge big races,
she needs to gain more real race experience
and build a stronger body than she has now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Therefore, the Junior Class should be a preparatory period for future challenges; it would be best to monitor the results of her training and run races that gauge her true ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And by stacking up results like this,
Hokko Tarumae's name recognition—
in other words, her fanbase—is bound to grow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be best if Hokko Tarumae's next goal
were tied to the growing number of fans she's sure to gain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That goal is, plain and simple—
choice_data_list: How about holding a solo event in Tomakomai?
Why don't we try holding a solo event in Tomakomai?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A-A solo event!?
Does that mean...
as a local idol?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. This is a goal Hokko Tarumae
can only achieve by working hard in her races
and local idol activities to raise her profile.
choice_data_list: I want to aim for a packed house at that solo event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Achieving this goal would serve as the greatest proof
that her reach and influence as Tomakomai's tourism ambassador
have truly grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering the current situation, it's a high hurdle to overcome.
However, Hokko Tarumae has a strong passion for Tomakomai. So—
choice_data_list: If it's you, Tarumae, I'm sure you can do it.
If it's you, Tarumae, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, the max and min capacity for venues in Tomakomai are—
This is the follower growth up to today—
And based on the data correlating with previous figures—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I want to take on this goal.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a difficult challenge too.
But if I can't even accomplish this much,
I'll never make it as a tourism ambassador. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If there's any chance to bring people to Tomakomai,
I want to give it my all to seize it every single time...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Now that that's settled, first we need to find a venue.
I'll make full use of all my connections!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having set our goals with Hokko Tarumae,
we began taking action toward them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after starting the search for a venue,
that news arrived out of nowhere...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...All right, I'm getting the hang of it!
Next, I need to watch my positioning on the corners—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!?
Why are you in such a rush?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking it'd be faster to show her than explain,
I showed Hokko Tarumae, who was in the middle of self-training,
the email that had just arrived for me...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The sender is... the Tomakomai Tourism Association...?
"We would love to cooperate on Hokko Tarumae's solo event"!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If it's next spring, you may use this venue."
Wait, this venue...!
It's one of the biggest in all of Tomakomai, isn't it!?
choice_data_list: Actually, I just got a phone call earlier—

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Tourism Association Staff
text_block_list.text: "—Seeing Hokko Tarumae-san's debut race truly moved our hearts."

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Tourism Association Staff
text_block_list.text: "'Seeing her work so hard to promote Tomakomai so far away from home, as a citizen of Tomakomai, I wanted to help—'"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Nnnngh!!
This is no time to be deeply moved, Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai is cheering for me this much...!
I have to, I absolutely HAVE to!!
Fill the venue and make this a success!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"We are deeeeeeeefinitely!!
going to pack this venue to the brim, okay!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To pack the house at the Tomakomai event next spring,
her days of challenging herself to raise her profile as a dirt Umamusume and local idol had begun!
